scope: Local sequential ABBA, fixed published85/87 bundles; draw completion only, no GPU/FPS/physical-device or production-network claim

method.harnessCachePolicy: Static dist/client files: Cache-Control public, max-age=3600. Worker HTML/API responses retain their original headers.
method.cold: Fresh browser context with empty browser cache/storage; shared browser process; OS/server/GPU caches are not cold
method.warm: Second navigation in the same context, resource cache evidence recorded
method.settle: Two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after opening controls and before edits, and before frame capture; outside measured input-to-completion interval
method.edits: Input event performance.now to current generation final draw timestamp; UI opening excluded
method.graphics: One valid SVG image containing 500 paths; complex-project-import includes JSON validation, recovery backup and rendering; subsequent complex-scene-cached-redraw reuses floor texture
method.frameCapture: First repeat only, all three cameras; exact canvas RGBA SHA256 and PNG, outside timed operations

startupByModel.w1: Legacy W1 fixed valid local draft seeded before navigation to /; W1 is not a public arena query option

cells.interpretation: Descriptive observations only; two runs of five samples per version do not establish statistical significance, p95 or a product SLA.
